about_the_game:
DeckTerra is a 4X Deckbuilder set in a vibrant fantasy landscape. Expand your empire with the power of magical spell cards to conquer your enemies!

In DeckTerra, you must make difficult decisions about which resources to produce, and how to optimize your production pipeline.

Can you fend off enemies until day 100 and conquer the map? 

Build An Assembly Line

Chain together the buildings in your empire to merge and upgrade resource cards! These resources provide gold, science, faith, and food which you can use to further expand your empire. 

Expand Your Empire

Make impactful decisions about which buildings to add to each city, each with their unique strengths and strategies!

Spend Your Gold Wisely

Purchase Relics and Items in the shop that change the rules and unlock new strategies. Manage your economy to fund your military and expansion through the ages. How long will your empire last?

short_description: 4X Deckbuilder where you harness magical spells to expand your empire. Make strategic decisions about what to construct in your cities to fend off enemies and conquer the map across infinite procedural landscapes. Play cards to take your empire from the stone age to the modern era and beyond!
